While these responsibilities can be challenging, they can also be incredibly rewarding. By embracing the opportunities and lessons that come with motherhood, you can cultivate a more patient, compassionate, and resilient outlook, which can have a positive impact on all areas of your life. Remember, it's essential to take care of yourself, too, amidst the demands of motherhood. Make time for self-care, prioritize your own needs, and seek support when you need it. By doing so, you'll be better equipped to navigate the challenges and joys of parenting, and you'll emerge stronger, wiser, and more fulfilled as a result.

Overall, the OP's concerns and actions seem reasonable and motivated by a desire to protect their daughter's well-being and autonomy. The ex's aggressive response and threat to pursue the matter in court seem unwarranted and overly dramatic.
